versions.content: If development error detection for the FrIf module is enabled: if the function FrIf_AllSlots is called before the FrIf was initialized successfully, the function Fr 77 of 162 Document ID 27: AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayInterface Specification of FlexRay Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 If_AllSlots shall raise the development error FRIF_E_UNINIT and return E_NOT_OK.
